title: OtaNotifyMsg
description: Topic dev/{mid}/{did}/ota/notify, cloud to device, QoS 1. Offers a firmware image. Verify manifest_sig with the bootloader key and refuse versions not higher than the running one.

url.description: Signed download URL, valid 1 hour; supports HTTP range requests.

manifest_sig.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the canonical JSON of manifest.

install_after.description: Do not reboot into the new image before this time (user maintenance window).
